label: nisouinai
title_raw: に相違ない [にそういない] (nisouinai)
title: に相違ない
meaning: Nobody argues; definitely; without a doubt
meaning_example: That's definitely the same color as the fabric.

notes.text:
＊This expression is nearly interchangeable with に違いない. However, に相違ない is a more formal expression.



FORMATION:

Ｖ(plain form) + に相違ない

Ｎ・なＡ + (である) + に相違ない

いＡ + に相違ない
